The SignIn RPC is defined on AuthService in the proto file.

The backend function is `APIV1Service.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`. A Connect wrapper `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `connect_services.go` delegates to it.

q04.

**APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go**

The `SignIn` RPC is defined on `AuthService` in `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto`. The backend implementation is the method on `APIV1Service` (which embeds `v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`):

```51:51:server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go
func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error) {
```

`ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` is a thin Connect adapter that delegates to `APIV1Service.SignIn`; the business logic lives in `auth_service.go`.
